title: Preserve reviewed migration checksums across Windows checkouts
summary: Pin five reviewed staging SQL files to LF without changing SQL or approved hashes. Production release remains blocked by a credential binding mismatch.

changes.detail: Add exact-path LF checkout rules for the five migrations used by the offline staging preparation checksum gate.
Normalize local checkout line endings to the existing approved bytes; no SQL behavior, expected hash or production database changes.

validation.name: Cause verification
validation.detail: All five files match existing pinned SHA-256 values after CRLF-to-LF conversion; raw Windows CRLF files failed.

validation.name: Production deployment
validation.detail: Existing hosted candidate failed public Supabase credential binding equality. No environment secrets exported or changed.
